findings: H1 2026 (six months to 30 Apr 2026): group revenue £154.3m (+0.3% vs H1 2025 £153.8m; -1.4% constant currency); EBITDA £57.0m (+7.1%; +4.5% CC); profit before tax £32.7m (-3.8%; -6.2% CC); profit after tax £24.5m (-4.3%); diluted EPS 6.48p (-3.9% vs 6.74p) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

PBT decline reflected slower revenue growth, shift from equipment sales to recurring vending revenue, higher depreciation (£23.5m), and a one-off H1 2025 gain of £1.6m on disposal of a Grenoble office — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

First five months of FY26 were broadly in line with Board expectations; April saw a vending revenue slowdown (photobooth activity down sharply in a small number of countries, plus softer laundry); Board attributed this to cautious consumer sentiment, especially in France (largest/most profitable market), linked to Middle East conflict and geopolitical uncertainty — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

FY26 outlook reaffirmed at revised profit before tax range £69m–£74m; group “on track to meet revised full year expectations”; Board taking a cautious full-year view mindful of geopolitical factors — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

H2 2026 to date (May/June): trading returned to more normal patterns; May 2026 total vending revenue +11.1% YoY (Wash.ME +25.9%, Photo.ME +1.8%); positive trend continued in June; laundry in France back to levels similar to first five months; photobooth demand partially recovered but not expected to return to prior levels while travel uncertainty persists — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Wash.ME: vending revenue £54.8m (+16.3%; +12.7% CC) vs £47.1m; EBITDA £30.7m (+20.9%); 499 net new machines (8,106 total); 38.4% of group vending revenue and 53.9% of group EBITDA; April Wash.ME growth only +3.0% vs April 2025 — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Photo.ME: vending revenue £77.6m (-6.2%; -6.8% CC) vs £82.7m; EBITDA £27.2m (-8.1%); April Photo.ME vending revenue -17% YoY; avg revenue per booth £2,549 (-5.7%) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Equipment sales revenue down 14.2% YoY (Chairman’s statement cites ~14% lower), reflecting strategic prioritisation of operating higher-margin instant-service equipment over machine sales — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

France: April softness across photobooths and, to a lesser extent, laundry; trading improved since April; renewed SNCF (5-year) and RATP (7-year) contracts representing >£9.0m revenue; 818 next-generation photobooths installed in France in H1 — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Germany: Photo.ME decline driven by May 2025 regulatory changes requiring passport photos in citizens’ offices or by certified photographers; excluding Germany, Continental Europe Photo.ME vending revenue +5.0%; Continental Europe operating profit -4.9% to £31.0m — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Cash: gross cash £52.8m (vs £66.4m H1 2025); net cash £7.5m (vs £27.6m); net cash down from £26.5m at 31 Oct 2025; lease liabilities excluded from net cash total £10.0m — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Cash generated from operations £38.7m (-18.9% vs £47.7m), driven by working capital (inventory +£8.3m, payables -£6.3m); net cash from operating activities £32.2m; total capex £33.9m (+18% vs £28.8m), 68% on laundry/photobooth (Wash.ME £14.9m, Photo.ME £8.2m) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Interim dividend cut 6.5% to 3.60p (H1 2025: 3.85p), returning £13.5m; ex-div 5 Nov 2026, pay 27 Nov 2026; policy remains >55% of annual profits after tax; H1 dividend cover ~1.8x on diluted EPS (6.48p / 3.60p) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Liquidity: group states strong balance sheet and good liquidity to fund growth; going concern confirms sufficient financing for at least 12 months and adequate resources for foreseeable future; no material uncertainties identified — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/MEGP.L/20260816T091024Z/sources/filings/bodies/ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
